scope: One frozen outside-ROI temporal-control source-calibrated electronic noise mean application. No target ROI data enters z_control; existing saved pilot contributes covariance/state and the separately reported curvature diagnostic only. No fit or PSD retuning.

equations.unchanged_error_comparison: r_before=data-mean; r_after=r_before-m_noise; original ERR is not changed

optional_control_photon_projection.law: Independent incident Poisson electrons at fixed positive preIPC pilot rates; CovN(t,s)=diag(lambda min(t,s)); actual mean inverseL and H before two-read group average; fixed beta and SIRS mean/operator; finite context.
optional_control_photon_projection.additional_limits: Does not define unknown state-dependent collection/full-well noise or photon-driven changes of SIRS control coefficients. Supplies control-channel shot contamination only, not a completed target covariance.

nominal_control_Poisson_contamination.interpretation: Best linear prediction of the electronic target residual and its error covariance from electronics plus independent Poisson control moments; not generally the exact conditional expectation after adding non-Gaussian Poisson noise.

limits: READ+DARK-only conditioning assumes all retained affine-free ADC control fluctuations are electronics/dark. Actual control source photon noise and nonlinear/variable light may contaminate this assumption; nominal source-shot variant is separate.

Affine temporal contrasts remove any static light only under an affine ADC response. The saved inverse-linearity/cap optical pilot predicts the reported curvature; it is not fitted to control agreement and not subtracted from observed controls.

The direct beta target-noise map holds physical caps/charge history fixed. Full translated cap/raw/post-SIRS/reference stochastic paths and target photon counting covariance remain unresolved in this component.
Stationary masked periodic spectral transfer and one independent calibration difference realization per epoch remain conditional. No target-error rescaling or spectral refit occurs.
This is previously consumed E4A, not unused validation, and no BHSM state kernel, Wick factorization, physical preparation or admission is inferred.
interpretation_review_correction: Only optional Poisson-contaminated control predictor terminology/array key corrected to best linear prediction; all numerical arrays and statistics unchanged. Main frozen Gaussian READ+DARK conditional application unchanged.
